---


Added a "Select All" feature to the wheel page. It:

1. **Appears above the places list** — Shows a checkbox with "Select All (X)" where X is the number of filtered places
2. **Toggles all filtered places** — Clicking selects all visible filtered places, or deselects them if all are already selected
3. **Shows correct state** — The checkbox reflects whether all filtered places are selected

The "Select All" checkbox only appears when there are filtered places to select, and it respects the current type filters (only selects/deselects the places currently visible after filtering).
